refinementNotes: Phase B review completed for the latest Sky batch. Raw VoiceOver output remains the oracle except for evidence-backed OCR cleanup: £200/£0pm currency, smart apostrophes/en dash in marketing copy, missing spaces in speed-card captions, a stray leading bullet before Get online, and OCR confusion between I/l in FAQ text.

Restored the first three FAQ headings to the raw expanded button/group VoiceOver phrasing because step snapshots show focused expanded accordion buttons; the Phase A stripped headings were over-cleaned.

Remaining mismatches are candidate evidence: the engine groups/splits marketing list cards differently, omits or truncates several FAQ body snippets relative to the captured VoiceOver stream, and differs on text-field invalid phrasing and accordion list-position ordering. No reusable engine change was made from this single page.

notes: refinedAnnouncements contain only high-confidence OCR/system-caption corrections.
Fixtures with skipCorpusReason are excluded from opt-in corpus gating until manually refined.
